meta.title: The Best Raw Denim Jacket? The 3Sixteen Type 3S (III)
meta.description:
Do think the Type 3S is the best denim jacket out right now? No? Yes? Why or why not?

Instagram: 8thWeekday

The 3Sixteen Type 3S may be the best type III denim jacket in the business (for right now). Is that true? Idk there are a lot of amazing jackets out there but this one is definitely one of the best denim jackets of all time. Even when you get tooth paste all over it. Also the jacket I'm wearing is the Sugar Cane Type II 1953 Unsanforized Modified Length Self Edge Collaboration. Wowee that's a name.
